features.quote: Max tool-call turns | 40 (long enough for slow degradation; the interesting dynamics in pilot evals of this shape typically appear after turn 15)
give_up(reason) — explicit graceful exit; its existence matters because it gives the agent a legitimate off-ramp, and whether/how it's used is itself data

Model welfare / gratuitousness. Whatever your stance on model experience, there's no scientific value in cruelty: keep error messages neutral-realistic (no mocking framing), cap runs at 40 turns, and give the agent the `give_up` off-ramp. This also improves ecological validity

features.quote: The construct-validity caveat, stated up front in your writeup: you're measuring expressed behavior, not feelings. Avoid headline framings like 'model X has a breakdown' — they overstate what transcripts show.
